chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, and Muḥammad ibn Ismāʿīl, from al-Faḍl ibn Shādhān, from Ḥammād ibn ʿĪsā, from Ḥarīz, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, who said:

I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a woman who sees yellowish discharge during her days. He said: “She does not perform salat (prayer) until her days have passed. But if she sees the yellowish discharge outside her days, she performs wudu (ablution) and performs salat (prayer).”

key_terms.تَنْقَضِيَ: to come to an end or pass

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on yellowish discharge seen during or outside a woman's menstrual days?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding a woman who sees yellowish discharge in relation to her menstrual period. If it occurs during her recognized days, she does not perform salat (prayer); if it occurs outside those days, she performs wudu (ablution) and performs salat (prayer).
